questions.answer: I don't know.

questions.answer: I did not participate in any, so I cannot comment.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Just try to enjoy everyday life in Milan and not stress about going out of town all the time + be careful to have to many people visiting from DK since it can distance you from the people you are trying to sociale with in Milan.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be open to people you maybe normally don't see yourself hanging out with.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Being back in Italy where I have lived in the past.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Be prepared for the academic level being if not lower, then at least different. 
Don't stress over the teachers being vague about exams, etc. you will figure it out in the end.
Don't stress about experiencing a lot of things, just enjoy the city and the people.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: That the university system is very different but that it is interesting to experience something very different to what we're used to in Denmark. Be patient.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The friends I got.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Letting go of the stress of having to get as much out of it as possible. It was the small everyday moments that made the exchange amazing.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
